observe(at("company.senior_notes.5_25_percent_due_april_2023.carrying_amount", "2019"), 422.0, "million_usd", cell("5.25% Senior Notes due April 2023", "Carrying Amount"))
member("company.senior_notes_due_by_december_2024.carrying_amounts", "company.senior_notes.5_25_percent_due_april_2023.carrying_amount", cell("5.25% Senior Notes due April 2023", "Carrying Amount"))
observe(at("company.senior_notes.4_50_percent_due_september_2023.carrying_amount", "2019"), 445.6, "million_usd", cell("4.50% Senior Notes due September 2023(1)", "Carrying Amount"))

member("company.senior_notes_due_by_december_2024.carrying_amounts", "company.senior_notes.4_50_percent_due_september_2023.carrying_amount", cell("4.50% Senior Notes due September 2023(1)", "Carrying Amount"))

f3_program: collection("janice.weekly_pay.components", "pay_amount", "janice", source("Janice gets paid $10 an hour for the first 40 hours she works each week, and $15 each hour of overtime after that"))
observe(at("janice.pay.regular_rate", "week"), 10, "usd_per_hour", source("$10 an hour"))
observe(at("janice.pay.overtime_rate", "week"), 15, "usd_per_hour", source("$15 each hour of overtime"))
observe(at("janice.pay.regular_hours_cap", "week"), 40, "hour", source("the first 40 hours she works each week"))
observe(at("janice.work.total_hours", "week"), 60, "hour", source("Janice works 60 hours one week"))
minimum_relation(at("janice.work.regular_hours", "week"), at("janice.work.total_hours", "week"), at("janice.pay.regular_hours_cap", "week"), source("the first 40 hours she works each week"))

difference_relation(at("janice.work.overtime_hours", "week"), at("janice.work.total_hours", "week"), at("janice.work.regular_hours", "week"), source("$10 an hour for the first 40 hours she works each week, and $15 each hour of overtime after that"))

rate_relation(at("janice.pay.regular_amount", "week"), at("janice.pay.regular_rate", "week"), at("janice.work.regular_hours", "week"), source("$10 an hour for the first 40 hours she works each week"))
rate_relation(at("janice.pay.overtime_amount", "week"), at("janice.pay.overtime_rate", "week"), at("janice.work.overtime_hours", "week"), source("$15 each hour of overtime after that"))
member("janice.weekly_pay.components", "janice.pay.regular_amount", source("$10 an hour for the first 40 hours she works each week"))
member("janice.weekly_pay.components", "janice.pay.overtime_amount", source("$15 each hour of overtime after that"))
query("sum", "janice.weekly_pay.components", "week")
assumptions: The first-40-hours clause defines regular hours as the lesser of total hours and the 40-hour cap; overtime consists of hours after that tier.

f3_program: multiple(at("frank.age", "plus_5_year"), at("ty.age", "now"), 3, source("In 5 years, Frank will be three times as old as Ty is now"))
offset(at("ty.age", "now"), scale(at("carla.age", "now"), 2), 4, "year", source("Ty is currently 4 years more than two times as old as Carla is now"))

query("value", at("frank.age", "plus_5_year"))

collection("angela.kitchen_supply_counts", "count", "angela", source("Angela's kitchen supplies which consist of 20 pots, 6 more than three times as many plates as the pots, and half as many cutlery as the plates"))

collection("sharon.desired_kitchen_supply_counts", "count", "sharon", source("Sharon wants to buy half as many pots as Angela, 20 less than three times as many plates as Angela, and twice as much cutlery as Angela"))
observe(at("angela.kitchen_supplies.pots.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("20 pots"))
offset(at("angela.kitchen_supplies.plates.count", "current"), scale(at("angela.kitchen_supplies.pots.count", "current"), 3), 6, "count", source("6 more than three times as many plates as the pots"))
fraction_of(at("angela.kitchen_supplies.cutlery.count", "current"), at("angela.kitchen_supplies.plates.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("half as many cutlery as the plates"))
member("angela.kitchen_supply_counts", "angela.kitchen_supplies.pots.count", source("20 pots"))
member("angela.kitchen_supply_counts", "angela.kitchen_supplies.plates.count", source("6 more than three times as many plates as the pots"))
member("angela.kitchen_supply_counts", "angela.kitchen_supplies.cutlery.count", source("half as many cutlery as the plates"))
fraction_of(at("sharon.desired_kitchen_supplies.pots.count", "current"), at("angela.kitchen_supplies.pots.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("half as many pots as Angela"))

offset(at("sharon.desired_kitchen_supplies.plates.count", "current"), scale(at("angela.kitchen_supplies.plates.count", "current"), 3), -20, "count", source("20 less than three times as many plates as Angela"))
multiple(at("sharon.desired_kitchen_supplies.cutlery.count", "current"), at("angela.kitchen_supplies.cutlery.count", "current"), 2, source("twice as much cutlery as Angela"))
member("sharon.desired_kitchen_supply_counts", "sharon.desired_kitchen_supplies.pots.count", source("half as many pots as Angela"))
member("sharon.desired_kitchen_supply_counts", "sharon.desired_kitchen_supplies.plates.count", source("20 less than three times as many plates as Angela"))
member("sharon.desired_kitchen_supply_counts", "sharon.desired_kitchen_supplies.cutlery.count", source("twice as much cutlery as Angela"))
query("sum", "sharon.desired_kitchen_supply_counts", "current")
